name: Geethanjali Dilip

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Geethanjali Dilip is a poet and French educator associated with Zone Francofone in Salem, Tamil Nadu. Her literary work includes collaborative anthologies and the curation of the Yercaud Poetry Festival. Her collections include Geethatmaa: Song of the Soul and Rosée: The Dewdrop.

The poems gathered here move between intimate connection and public grief. ‘Lines’ follows a relationship beyond telephone wires into the quiet language of touch. ‘When it all reflects’ brings together images of womanhood and the earth’s abundance, while ‘Wasted Penance’ questions the human cost hidden beneath war songs, medals and patriotic ceremony.
